context: Request: the latest Bankruptcy & Restructuring matter where a plan of reorganization the firm produced was confirmed (to lead a pitch). Rubric: 1006-00002 (Crestline Packaging, plan confirmed September 2022) plus a precision criterion.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out after printing about 141K chars of partial hits. The review suggests a chunked scan step.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same core procedure: path searches and store-wide text scans surface one matter with a full court-filing package (order entered, effectiveness notices); reads of those documents and of later candidates' engagement letters, financing orders and closing papers show the later matters had no confirmed plan the firm produced (T2 found one later confirmation where the firm acted for the lender and kept it as a near miss). Runs differ in how many agent-declared steps they added after reviews (T0 five new step names for date comparison and later-matter checks; T1 four; T2 none). Reviews kept flagging unopened surfaced matters; none changed the answer.
